about_the_game:
Adult Content Disclosure

This game contains fictional depictions of crime, fictional drug production, drug dealing, gun violence, and adult themes. It does not provide real-world instructions or promote illegal activities.


Build a cartel empire in a stylized crime simulation. Gather seeds from the dark web, grow and process crops, fulfill risky customer orders, outsmart the police and rival gangs, scale deliveries from customer pickups to trucks and planes, hire workers, and manage two cities.

About This Game

Cartel & Economy Sim is currently in Early Access.
The current version includes core gameplay systems, while additional mechanics and expanded features are in active development and will be introduced progressively.

Start Small

Begin with limited sourcing mechanics and complete basic deliveries to earn money. Lay the foundation of your operation and grow step by step.

Note: The economy system is currently in an early-stage implementation and will be expanded in future updates.

Risk & Pressure

Navigate the world while managing existing risk elements. The current build includes basic threat mechanics.
Advanced patrol systems, rival gang AI, and raid events are planned for upcoming updates.

Logistics & Progression (Early Version)

The game currently features small-scale delivery and progression mechanics.
Expanded vehicle logistics (cars, vans, pickups), large-scale shipments, and advanced scaling systems are planned during Early Access.

The progression system is currently limited and will be expanded.

Crew & Property Systems (Planned)

Worker management, island ownership, and advanced base systems are part of the Early Access roadmap and are not yet fully implemented.

Early Access Notice

Cartel & Economy Sim is currently in Early Access.
Some systems listed below are planned for future updates and are not yet fully implemented.

We are actively developing and expanding the game with community feedback.

Current Core Gameplay

Economy Simulation (Early Stage)
Build the foundations of your operation through sourcing and fulfilling basic orders within a risk/reward structure.

Open World Environment
Explore a stylized low-polygon city and rural town setting.

Progression System (Basic)
Grow from small-scale street operations toward larger logistics chains.

Planned Features (In Development)

The following systems are actively planned and will be introduced progressively during Early Access:

Expanded Cartel & Economy System

  • Advanced sourcing

  • Growing & processing mechanics

  • Dynamic client orders

Dark Web Marketplace System

  • Anonymous supplier/buyer network

  • Risk-based transactions

  • Consequence system

Rivals & Law Enforcement AI

  • Patrol units

  • Territory conflicts

  • Raid mechanics

Guns & Tactical Gameplay

  • Stealth deliveries

  • Firefights

  • Long-range engagements

Operation Scaling

  • Vehicle-based logistics (cars, pickups, trucks)

  • Large-scale shipments (air transport)

Crew Management System

  • Hire workers

  • Assign logistics

  • Security roles

Property & Base Ownership

  • Safehouses

  • Island base expansion

Visual Style

A stylized experience blending a sharp low-polygon cityscape with a dusty rural town atmosphere.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit) or higher
  • Processor: 3 GHZ 4 Core or similar
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1060 or Radeon RX 580
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit) or higher
  • Processor: 4 GHZ 6 Core or similar
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 3060 or Radeon RX 6700
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: Start as a small producer, produce and distribute. Fight rival gangs and become the baron of two cities.
